description: Reference Java & Spring implementation of the Open Ingestion Standard (OIS). It provides a secure, decoupled, and vendor-neutral enterprise data integration platform leveraging modern Java 25 features, Spring Boot, Spring AI and vector search infrastructure to orchestrate data flows
